section: Review Candidate Configuration / Validate Configuration / Safe Commit / Verification
content:
# Review Candidate Configuration / Validate Configuration / Safe Commit / Verification

Before committing:

show | compare

---

Run:

commit check

Correct any errors before continuing.

---

If management connectivity could be affected:

commit confirmed

Verify connectivity before confirming the commit.

---

After commit, verify interfaces:

show interfaces terse

Verify default route:

show route 0.0.0.0/0

Verify security zones:

show security zones

Verify security policy:

show security policies

Verify source NAT:

show security nat source rule all

Verify active sessions:

show security flow session

---
